title: Glass Heart Anthem
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: Bright, euphoric dance-pop with a bouncy four-on-the-floor pulse, glossy plucky arps and a chopped vocal hook. It blooms from an atmospheric intro into a big radio-ready chorus, drops to a felt-piano breakdown, then climbs to an even bigger second chorus before a soft outro.
